chunks: And with this chain, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from Aban, from Abu Ja'far al-Ahwal, from Yasar ibn Yasar, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): 'For what reason is Wednesday fasted?' He replied: 'Because Hell was created on Wednesday.'
ai.seo_question: Why is fasting recommended on Wednesday according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elucidates the wisdom behind fasting on Wednesday by linking it to the creation of Hellfire on that day, a concept rooted in Shia hadith literature that emphasizes spiritual purification through remembrance of the Hereafter. This specific narration from *Thawab al-A'mal* highlights the eschatological dimension of voluntary fasting, encouraging believers to draw closer to Allah by mitigating the effects of Hellfire through righteous deeds on this significant day.
